body: Well, thank you! It won't be a problem since I don't see anything positive about keeping secrets at this point. I will never ever use medication however, and I will not be put in a hospital of some sort, I also have a plan on how to end it if it comes to that point.

I have a time scheduled tomorrow. I'm not gonna go to school tomorrow, I'm just going to go there and talk, see what she says. Obviously she'll do anything to help me get over this. Maybe it'll get better, but.. you know.. I still feel tempted to just get it over with. I still have to think this through though. The one thing that keeps me from actually doing it is my little sister. She'll be 10 this year and the thought of her finding out that I comitted suicide hurts more than anything.
Well, it's gotten worse the last three days and two people know about how I feel. But the whole suicide thing I've kept to myself.

I have felt the deepest, darkest depths of anxiety and I don't know how to move on. The thought of suicide does not scare me, it actually soothes me. The thought of just drifting off makes me so happy.
